reviews.title: Deleted Half my List
reviews.text: I was at the store with my shopping list and the app randomly deleted half my list. Wasn’t completed, just gone. Tried to reload the app and wouldn’t work. Not using this app again l.

reviews.title: Unable to share list
reviews.text:
My wife and I have been using this app for years, and all of a sudden it’s not sharing any of the the list. that we create, which is extremely frustrating. it appears that they’ve taken away the ability to share the list and to synchronize amongst each other
I have arrived at the store with a complete list and then my wife might add on one or two things. and I am unable to verify unless she contacts me to update the list.
Also, there’s no ability to purchase the app to see if there’s an upgrade. It appears that it’s been taken away.
No support and seems to be inactive, which means possibly changing to another app altogether

reviews.title: Does not always sync
reviews.text: I wanted this app to sync with other users, but for some reason we have to continuously refresh to receive the updates list.

reviews.title: Syncing between users stopped working
reviews.text: That was my main reason for using this whole app, I’ve lived this app for years and now I’m deleting it :(

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Wouldn’t sync my list with my partner then logged me out and wouldn’t let me back in.

reviews.title: Doesn’t sync
reviews.text: I’m not sure if it’s because my partner has an android. But this app doesn’t sync at all. It’s gotten to the point we have to screenshot our list to see if they’re matching up. Deleting this app. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Not syncing
reviews.text: I have tried everything to sync this. I deleted the app, of course my list disappeared. I re-added it and still it does not sync.    Very frustrating.

reviews.title: Zero support
reviews.text: This app likes one basic very important feature. You cannot search your pantry items. I reached out to support for help regarding this issue and got back nothing.

reviews.title: Used to Love it
reviews.text: The shopping totals are all wrong, for example, 2 toiletries items totaling $6 but it shows as $872. I can no longer auto arrange alphabetically or copy and move items to other lists. The formatting is all crowded. I now HATE it.

reviews.title: Doesn’t sync well
reviews.text:
We’ve used this app for years because it was too annoying to switch. But the failure to sync reliably is not acceptable anymore. It’s literally the only thing this list needs to be able to do well. And it doesn’t do it.

Can’t tell you how many times someone has added items to the list but the person at the store didn’t see them because the syncing failed.

reviews.title: Can’t move pantry items to a list
reviews.text: Since this latest update, when I try to move items from my party, the move button is blocked by the setting button. This is on an iPhone. Please fix this. I love this app!
